description: The complete end-to-end software engineering path: beginner Java programming, object-oriented design, SQL, Spring Boot microservices, plus modern frontend development with HTML5, CSS3, ES6+ JavaScript, React 18, and full-stack integration.

phases.title: Java Programming Foundations
phases.description: Master program structure, data types, operators, loops, arrays, and error debugging from absolute scratch.

topics.title: Java Setup, Anatomy of a Program & The Compiler
topics.summary: Understand JDK installation, the main method signature, javac bytecode compilation, and running your first program.

topics.title: Variables, Primitive Data Types & Memory Sizes
topics.summary: Explore primitive types (byte, short, int, long, float, double, char, boolean), bit-widths, literals, and type casting.

topics.title: Operators, Expressions & Precedence Rules
topics.summary: Master arithmetic, relational, logical short-circuit, bitwise, and assignment operators with evaluation order.

topics.title: Conditional Control Flow (if-else, Ternary, switch)
topics.summary: Direct execution paths using branching statements, switch expressions (Java 14+), and guarding against logical flaws.

topics.title: Iteration & Loops (while, do-while, for, loop controls)
topics.summary: Master repetitive logic, loop invariants, nested loops, break, continue, and avoiding infinite loops.

topics.title: Methods, Scope & Parameter Passing (Pass-by-Value)
topics.summary: Deconstruct method signatures, return values, method overloading, stack frames, and Java's strict pass-by-value model.

topics.title: Arrays: 1D & 2D Arrays, Indexing & Memory Traversal
topics.summary: Understand fixed-size indexed arrays, contiguous heap layout, default values, bounds checking, and matrix algorithms.

topics.title: String Basics, Concatenation & Immutability Intro
topics.summary: Work with text, common String methods, char conversion, indexing, substring parsing, and why strings are immutable.

topics.title: Debugging Code, Compiler Errors & Reading Stack Traces
topics.summary: Learn IDE debugging, setting breakpoints, stepping through execution, and interpreting NullPointer & IndexOutOfBounds traces.

phases.title: OOP & Class Design
phases.description: Model real-world systems cleanly using encapsulation, constructors, inheritance, interfaces, and practical design principles.

topics.title: Classes, Objects & The new Instantiation Lifecycle
topics.summary: Bridge from procedural to object-oriented programming: state, behavior, object references, and heap allocation.

topics.title: Constructors, Overloading & The this Reference
topics.summary: Master object initialization, default constructors, parameterized constructors, constructor chaining, and the this keyword.

topics.title: Access Modifiers & Encapsulation (Getters/Setters)
topics.summary: Protect object invariants using private fields, validation within setters, defensive copying, and package-private scoping.

topics.title: Developer Tools I: Git Version Control for Multi-File Projects
topics.summary: Track multi-file codebases: git init, staging, commits, branch management, merge conflicts, and GitHub remote workflows.

topics.title: Static Members: Class Variables, Methods & Execution Blocks
topics.summary: Differentiate per-class static members from per-instance members, static utility methods, and static initialization blocks.

topics.title: Inheritance, Method Overriding & The super Keyword
topics.summary: Extend classes safely, understand method overriding rules, super constructor invocation, and the Object root class.

topics.title: Polymorphism: Compile-Time vs Dynamic Method Dispatch
topics.summary: Harness runtime polymorphism, upcasting, downcasting with instanceof, and vtable dynamic dispatch mechanics.

topics.title: Abstract Classes vs Interfaces & Multiple Inheritance of Type
topics.summary: Design flexible system contracts: abstract base classes vs interfaces, default/static interface methods, and loose coupling.

topics.title: Composition (HAS-A) vs Inheritance (IS-A) & Practical SOLID
topics.summary: Avoid fragile class hierarchies: favor composition over inheritance, and apply Single Responsibility & Dependency Inversion.

phases.title: Core Java, Testing Foundations & Modern Java 8+
phases.description: Write defensive, idiomatic Java using robust exception handling, Maven builds, JUnit 5 testing, and modern functional streams.

topics.title: Exception Architecture: try, catch, finally & throw/throws
topics.summary: Master runtime fault tolerance, try-catch-finally control flow, multi-catch blocks, and exception propagation up call stacks.

topics.title: Checked vs Unchecked Exceptions & Custom Domain Exceptions
topics.summary: Know when to use RuntimeException vs checked Exception, exception translation, and writing clean domain exception hierarchies.

topics.title: Developer Tools II: Maven Build Lifecycle & pom.xml Dependencies
topics.summary: Manage real-world enterprise builds: coordinate artifacts (groupId, artifactId), dependency scopes, plugins, and lifecycles.

topics.title: Developer Tools III: Unit Testing Foundations with JUnit 5
topics.summary: Verify code correctness: write unit tests using @Test, Assertions, @BeforeEach, and testing for thrown exceptions.

topics.title: String Constant Pool, Memory Internals & StringBuilder
topics.summary: Deep dive into String immutability, literal pooling, intern(), and using StringBuilder vs StringBuffer for string building.

topics.title: Wrapper Classes, Autoboxing Pitfalls & Enums
topics.summary: Work with Integer, Double, Boolean wrappers, avoid hidden NullPointerExceptions during unboxing, and build typesafe enums.

topics.title: Generics: Type Parameters, Generic Classes & Type Erasure
topics.summary: Eliminate ClassCastExceptions at runtime: parameterized types, bounded wildcards (extends vs super), and bytecode type erasure.

topics.title: The Object Contract: equals(), hashCode() & Identity vs Equality
topics.summary: Master the fundamental Java contract: why overriding equals requires overriding hashCode and how buckets depend on it.

topics.title: Modern Java 8: Functional Interfaces & Lambda Syntax
topics.summary: Embrace functional programming: Predicate, Function, Consumer, Supplier, custom @FunctionalInterface, and method references.

topics.title: Modern Java 8: Stream Pipelines (filter, map, collect) & Optional
topics.summary: Process data collections fluently: map-filter-reduce, groupingBy, lazy evaluation, and eliminating nulls with Optional.

phases.title: Data Structures & Java Collections Framework
phases.description: Choose the optimal data structure for the job based on Big-O time and space complexity trade-offs.

topics.title: Collections Overview, Hierarchy & Big-O Complexity Primer
topics.summary: Survey Iterable, Collection, List, Set, Queue, and Map interfaces with Big-O time complexity (O(1), O(log N), O(N)).

topics.title: List Interface: ArrayList (Dynamic Arrays & Resizing)
topics.summary: Understand dynamic resizing (1.5x growth), contiguous memory caching, index lookups, and fast traversal.

topics.title: LinkedList vs ArrayList: Memory Overheads & Big-O Realities
topics.summary: Compare doubly-linked nodes against array buffers: pointer overhead, CPU cache locality, and why ArrayList wins in practice.

topics.title: Set Interface: HashSet, LinkedHashSet & Uniqueness Guarantees
topics.summary: Store unique elements: HashSet backing HashMap mechanics, LinkedHashSet insertion order, and TreeSet red-black trees.

topics.title: Map Interface: HashMap Fundamentals & Key-Value Usage
topics.summary: Master key-value storage: put, get, getOrDefault, containsKey, keySet, values, entrySet, and handling null keys.

topics.title: HashMap Deep Dive: Buckets, Collisions & Treeification [ADVANCED]
topics.summary: Under the hood: hash calculation, bitwise mask indexing, load factors (0.75), bucket resizing, and treeification (threshold 8).

topics.title: Queue & Deque: FIFO Processing, ArrayDeque & PriorityQueue
topics.summary: Implement FIFO queues and double-ended queues with ArrayDeque, and natural heap ordering with PriorityQueue.

topics.title: Sorting Objects: Comparable vs Custom Comparator
topics.summary: Sort custom domain entities: natural ordering with compareTo() vs flexible multi-criteria sorting with Comparator.comparing().

phases.title: Under the Hood: JVM Architecture & Memory Mechanics
phases.description: Understand memory allocation, stack frames, heap generations, and garbage collection diagnostics.

topics.title: JDK vs JRE vs JVM & The Bytecode Execution Lifecycle
topics.summary: Demystify Java execution: compiler vs runtime, bytecode verification, JIT compilation (C1/C2), and HotSpot architecture.

topics.title: JVM Memory Architecture: Stack Frames, Heap & Metaspace
topics.summary: Inspect the runtime data areas: thread-private stack frames (LVT, operand stack) vs shared Java heap and native Metaspace.

topics.title: Garbage Collection Basics: How the JVM Frees Memory
topics.summary: Learn generational memory hypothesis: Young Gen (Eden, Survivor) vs Old Gen, root reachability, and mark-and-sweep.

topics.title: GC Collectors (G1, ZGC) & Stop-The-World Minimization [ADVANCED]
topics.summary: Examine production garbage collectors: G1 regional allocation, concurrent markings, ZGC low-latency colored pointers, and GC logs.

topics.title: Memory Leak Diagnostics, OutOfMemoryError & Heap Dumps [ADVANCED]
topics.summary: Detect unclosed resources, static collection bloat, ThreadLocal retention, and reading heap dumps with Eclipse MAT.

phases.title: Multithreading & Concurrent Programming
phases.description: Build thread-safe enterprise backend code that utilizes multi-core hardware safely.

topics.title: Threads, The Thread Class & Runnable Lifecycle
topics.summary: Create concurrent tasks with Runnable and Thread, explore thread states (NEW, RUNNABLE, BLOCKED, WAITING, TERMINATED).

topics.title: Race Conditions, Critical Sections & The synchronized Monitor
topics.summary: Identify data corruption in shared mutable state, synchronized methods vs blocks, and object intrinsic locks (monitors).

topics.title: Memory Visibility, volatile & Atomic Primitives (AtomicInteger)
topics.summary: Understand CPU caching, the volatile keyword visibility guarantee, happens-before relationships, and lock-free CAS atomics.

topics.title: Thread Coordination: wait(), notify() & Deadlock Avoidance
topics.summary: Coordinate producer-consumer workflows with wait and notifyAll, detect circular lock dependencies, and break deadlocks.

topics.title: Production Thread Management: ExecutorService & Thread Pools
topics.summary: Never create raw threads in production: FixedThreadPool, CachedThreadPool, WorkQueue rejection policies, and shutdown lifecycle.

topics.title: Asynchronous Tasks: Callable, Future & CompletableFuture [ADVANCED]
topics.summary: Return values from threads using Callable and Future, compose non-blocking asynchronous task pipelines with CompletableFuture.

topics.title: Concurrent Collections: ConcurrentHashMap & BlockingQueue [ADVANCED]
topics.summary: High-throughput thread safety: ConcurrentHashMap lock-striping vs Collections.synchronizedMap, and BlockingQueue for queues.

phases.title: Relational Databases & SQL Mastery
phases.description: Design normalized relational schemas and write production queries with joins, aggregations, and indexes.

topics.title: Relational Concepts: Tables, Primary Keys, Foreign Keys & Schema
topics.summary: Model relational entities: primary vs natural keys, foreign key constraints, column data types, and nullability rules.

topics.title: SQL CRUD Operations: CREATE, INSERT, SELECT, UPDATE, DELETE
topics.summary: Execute basic database statements, write WHERE clauses, handle transactions, and practice safe data modifications.

topics.title: Filtering, Sorting & Aggregations (WHERE, GROUP BY, HAVING)
topics.summary: Transform tabular data: aggregate functions (COUNT, SUM, AVG), GROUP BY data grouping, and post-aggregation filtering with HAVING.

topics.title: SQL Joins & MySQL Compatibility (INNER, LEFT, RIGHT, UNION)
topics.summary: Query across multiple tables with joins; understand MySQL's lack of native FULL OUTER JOIN and the standard UNION workaround.

topics.title: Subqueries, CTEs & Database Locking Mechanics
topics.summary: Write nested subqueries and readable Common Table Expressions (CTEs), and understand row vs table locks in relational engines.

topics.title: Database Normalization: 1NF, 2NF, 3NF & Denormalization Trade-offs
topics.summary: Design clean relational schemas: functional dependencies, 1NF atomic values, 2NF partial dependencies, 3NF transitive dependencies.

topics.title: ACID Properties & Transaction Isolation Levels
topics.summary: Understand Atomicity, Consistency, Isolation, Durability, Dirty Reads, Non-repeatable Reads, Phantom Reads, and isolation levels.

topics.title: B-Tree Indexes, Query Plans (EXPLAIN) & Optimization
topics.summary: Speed up queries with indexes: B+Tree index structures, composite index column order, clustered indexes, and ACID transactions.

phases.title: JDBC & Database Connectivity
phases.description: Connect Java applications directly to MySQL, prevent SQL injections, and manage connection pools.

topics.title: JDBC Architecture, Drivers & Establishing a Connection
topics.summary: Explore the JDBC abstraction layer: DriverManager, JDBC drivers, database URLs, and opening client-server socket connections.

topics.title: Safe Resource Management: try-with-resources & Connection Leaks
topics.summary: Prevent database connection exhaustion: AutoCloseable interface, try-with-resources statement, and closing statements and result sets.

topics.title: Statement vs PreparedStatement & SQL Injection Prevention
topics.summary: Understand SQL injection attacks: query plan precompilation, bind parameters (?), and why PreparedStatement is strictly mandatory.

topics.title: Querying & Processing Tabular Data with ResultSet
topics.summary: Iterate over query results: cursor movement with rs.next(), type-safe getters, handling NULL database values, and mapping to POJOs.

topics.title: Managing Database Transactions via JDBC (Commit, Rollback)
topics.summary: Control multi-step ACID operations: disabling auto-commit, executing transaction blocks, commit(), and rollback() on SQLException.

topics.title: Batch Updates & Production Connection Pooling with HikariCP
topics.summary: Accelerate multi-row inserts with addBatch(), eliminate TCP handshake costs using connection pools, and configure HikariCP.

phases.title: Enterprise Testing, Logging & Clean Code
phases.description: Write maintainable, test-driven backend code using Mockito, SLF4J, and design patterns.

topics.title: Advanced JUnit 5: Parameterized Tests, Nested Tests & Assertions
topics.summary: Write thorough test suites: @ParameterizedTest, @ValueSource, assertAll, and test lifecycle best practices.

topics.title: Mocking Dependencies with Mockito (@Mock, @InjectMocks, when)
topics.summary: Isolate unit tests: create test doubles with @Mock, inject dependencies with @InjectMocks, stub method calls, and verify invocations.

topics.title: Enterprise Logging: SLF4J Façade, Logback Configuration & AOP
topics.summary: Log like a production system: log levels (DEBUG, INFO, WARN, ERROR), parameterized logging, and cross-cutting timing with AOP.

topics.title: Creational Design Patterns: Singleton & Builder in Enterprise Java
topics.summary: Enforce single instances cleanly with thread-safe Singletons, and construct complex immutable entities with the Builder pattern.

topics.title: Structural & Behavioral Patterns: Factory, Strategy & Observer
topics.summary: Decouple object creation with Factory, swap runtime business algorithms with Strategy, and handle events with Observer.

topics.title: Refactoring Legacy Code & Code Smells to Clean Code
topics.summary: Apply Clean Code principles: meaningful naming, small single-responsibility methods, reducing cyclomatic complexity, and code smells.

phases.title: Spring Boot, REST APIs & Data Persistence
phases.description: Build production-grade REST microservices with Spring Boot, validation, and Spring Data JPA.

topics.title: Web Protocol Fundamentals: HTTP Verbs, Headers, Status Codes & REST
topics.summary: Understand HTTP client-server communication: GET, POST, PUT, DELETE idempotency, 2xx/4xx/5xx status codes, and URI naming.

topics.title: Spring Framework Core: Inversion of Control & Dependency Injection
topics.summary: Understand ApplicationContext, bean configuration, constructor injection vs field injection, and Singleton vs Prototype scopes.

topics.title: Spring Boot Auto-Configuration, Starters & Application Properties
topics.summary: Demystify @SpringBootApplication: starters, conditional beans (@ConditionalOnClass), externalized properties, and profiles.

topics.title: Building REST APIs: Controllers, Path Variables & Request Bodies
topics.summary: Expose JSON endpoints: @RestController, @PathVariable, @RequestParam, @RequestBody, and ResponseEntity payload envelopes.

topics.title: Request Validation (jakarta.validation), DTOs & Global Exceptions
topics.summary: Validate client payloads: @NotNull, @Size, @Email, and intercept controller errors centrally with @RestControllerAdvice.

topics.title: Spring Data JPA: Entity Lifecycle, Repositories & Auto-Queries
topics.summary: Map Java POJOs to tables: @Entity, @Id, @GeneratedValue, JpaRepository interface methods, and entity states (Transient, Persistent).

topics.title: JPA Entity Relationships: @ManyToOne, @OneToMany & Fetch Modes
topics.summary: Model relational associations in Hibernate: owning side, mappedBy, FetchType.LAZY vs EAGER, and cascade rules.

topics.title: The N+1 Query Problem & Remediation (JOIN FETCH, EntityGraphs)
topics.summary: Identify performance degradation: detect N+1 database queries in logs and fix them with JOIN FETCH and @EntityGraph.

topics.title: Transaction Management in Spring: @Transactional & Propagation
topics.summary: Manage multi-repository operations: proxy semantics, REQUIRED vs REQUIRES_NEW propagation, and rollbackOn exceptions.

topics.title: Pagination, Dynamic Filtering & API Testing with MockMvc
topics.summary: Return large datasets safely with Pageable and Page<T>, and verify REST controllers with MockMvc integration tests.

phases.title: Production Engineering, Security & Docker
phases.description: Secure APIs with JWT, containerize with Docker, and process asynchronous events with RabbitMQ.

topics.title: Spring Security Architecture & Filter Chain Demystified
topics.summary: Deconstruct SecurityFilterChain: SecurityContextHolder, Authentication vs Authorization, and configuring permitAll routes.

topics.title: Password Hashing with BCrypt, Salting & Brute-Force Defense
topics.summary: Never store plaintext passwords: cryptographic salts, adaptive work factor in BCrypt, and protecting against rainbow tables.

topics.title: Stateless API Security: JWT Authentication, Claims & Bearer Auth
topics.summary: Issue and validate stateless tokens: Header, Payload, Signature, custom claims, and implementing OncePerRequestFilter.

topics.title: Docker Basics: Writing Dockerfiles & Multi-Stage JRE Builds
topics.summary: Package backend services: container layers, writing production Dockerfiles, multi-stage builds, and running containerized Java apps.

topics.title: Docker Compose: Multi-Service Orchestration (Spring Boot + MySQL)
topics.summary: Orchestrate local environments: docker-compose.yml, environment variables, internal bridge networks, and database volumes.

topics.title: Message Brokers: Decoupling Microservices with RabbitMQ [ADVANCED]
topics.summary: Asynchronous messaging: Producer-Consumer pattern, Exchanges, Queues, Bindings, acknowledgments, and dead-letter queues.

topics.title: High-Performance Caching with Redis & The Cache-Aside Pattern [ADVANCED]
topics.summary: Accelerate read latency: Redis in-memory key-value store, cache invalidation strategies, TTL expiration, and spring-boot-starter-data-redis.

phases.title: Modern Frontend Foundations (HTML5, CSS3 & JavaScript ES6+)
phases.description: Build responsive, accessible user interfaces using semantic HTML5, modern CSS3 Flexbox/Grid, and modern JavaScript.

topics.title: Semantic HTML5, Document Structure & Web Accessibility (a11y)
topics.summary: Structure modern web applications with semantic tags (header, nav, main, section, article), accessible forms, and inputs.

topics.title: CSS3 Styling: The Box Model, Flexbox & CSS Grid Layouts
topics.summary: Master modern responsive layout techniques: margin, border, padding, flexbox axis alignment, grid columns, and media queries.

topics.title: Modern JavaScript (ES6+): Variables (let/const), Types & Functions
topics.summary: Master core JavaScript syntax: scope, arrow functions, template literals, array destructuring, and object spread operators.

topics.title: Asynchronous JavaScript: Promises, async/await & The Fetch API
topics.summary: Understand the browser event loop, consume HTTP endpoints with fetch(), handle errors with try-catch, and parse JSON responses.

phases.title: Modern React 18 & Full-Stack Integration
phases.description: Develop single-page applications with React 18, manage component state with Hooks, and integrate with Spring Boot APIs.

topics.title: React 18 Core: JSX Syntax, Functional Components & Props
topics.summary: Understand declarative UI programming: component hierarchy, JSX transpilation, passing props, and one-way data flow.

topics.title: React Hooks: Managing State with useState & Side Effects with useEffect
topics.summary: Control component state transitions with useState, synchronize external API data with useEffect, and avoid infinite render loops.

topics.title: Forms & User Input: Controlled Components & Client Validation
topics.summary: Handle forms in React: form submission events, controlled inputs, error display, and client-side validation.

topics.title: Client-Side Routing with React Router v6 & Navigation Guards
topics.summary: Build multi-page SPAs: BrowserRouter, Routes, Route, Link, useParams, and redirecting unauthenticated users.

topics.title: Full-Stack Integration: Axios HTTP Client, Interceptors & JWT Auth
topics.summary: Connect React to Spring Boot: configure Axios baseURL, attach Bearer tokens via interceptors, and handle 401 token expiration.

phases.title: Full-Stack Capstone Project & Deployment
phases.description: Build and deploy a complete production application connecting React 18, Spring Boot, MySQL, and Docker Compose.

topics.title: Full-Stack Capstone: Architecture, Design System & REST Contracts
topics.summary: Architect the complete system: wireframes, API contracts, CORS configuration, and establishing clean shared DTO boundaries.

topics.title: Full-Stack Capstone Implementation: React Frontend + Spring Backend
topics.summary: Implement end-to-end features: user registration, JWT login, interactive dashboard, database CRUD, and live state updates.

topics.title: Full-Stack Orchestration: Dockerizing React (Nginx) & Spring Boot
topics.summary: Containerize the full stack: multi-stage build for React with Nginx, Spring Boot backend container, MySQL container, and Docker Compose.

topics.title: Full-Stack Technical Interview Mastery: Explaining the Architecture
topics.summary: Walk interviewers through your full-stack application: defend architectural decisions, state management trade-offs, and security practices.
